name: Alex Morgan
focus: High School Economics Clubs & Peer Seminars
quote: “The most interesting part is seeing how a question changes when someone brings a different local perspective.”
bio: Organizes bi-weekly economics case discussions across regional high schools and introduces students to OEP’s interactive supply-and-demand modules.

name: Maya Shah
focus: A-Level Study Networks & Public Library Sessions
quote: “Open access materials give students the confidence to question assumptions and defend their reasoning.”
bio: Partners with sixth-form colleges and community libraries to host A-Level revision workshops and introductory financial literacy seminars.

name: Aarav Mehta
quote: “Connecting classroom theory to everyday urban markets makes economics immediately relevant to students here.”
bio: Leads student outreach across Mumbai and coordinates collaborative problem-solving sessions for aspiring economics olympiad participants.

name: Diya Rao
focus: IB Economics Case Analysis & Youth Forums
quote: “Good economic education teaches you how to weigh trade-offs thoughtfully rather than memorize definitions.”
bio: Facilitates cross-school policy case discussions and curates student feedback to help refine OEP’s international curriculum units.

name: Rohan Kapoor
quote: “Bringing students from different international curricula into one room creates the sharpest economic debates.”
bio: Coordinates inter-school economics roundtables and introduces OEP learning loops to student-led societies across the Gulf region.

name: Sofia Lindqvist
quote: “Students care deeply about climate and public policy; economics gives them the analytical toolkit to evaluate solutions.”
bio: Leads workshops on externalities and environmental economics for upper-secondary students in Helsinki.

name: Lukas Weber
quote: “Translating economic concepts accurately means adapting institutional examples so local learners immediately connect.”
bio: Supports German-language terminology review and organizes student discussion groups focused on European macroeconomic policy.

name: Kwame Mensah
quote: “When learning materials are open and practical, students immediately apply them to local entrepreneurship and development.”
bio: Works with local educators and youth organizations in Accra to expand access to foundational microeconomics and financial literacy resources.

name: Nadia Putri
quote: “Peer-led workshops turn intimidating graphs into visual stories that everyone in the room can understand.”
bio: Coordinates online and school-based study circles across Jakarta, helping students bridge gaps in exam preparation.

name: Mateo Morales
quote: “Opening our chapter in Mexico City allowed us to connect Spanish-speaking learners with rigorous, accessible materials.”
bio: Spearheads OEP’s newest Latin American chapter, collaborating on Spanish localization and high school outreach.

name: Aarav Adhikari
quote: “Even a single well-structured workshop can spark a student’s lifelong interest in how economies work.”
bio: Leads OEP’s Kathmandu chapter, partnering with local schools and community libraries to distribute open study guides.

name: Elena Popescu
quote: “Combining quantitative reasoning with real-world case defense prepares students for both competitions and university.”
bio: Coordinates Bucharest student study groups focused on quantitative economic reasoning and graph interpretation.

name: Timur Aliyev
quote: “OpenEconomics gives ambitious learners in Central Asia a shared benchmark to test their ideas globally.”
bio: Connects high school economics clubs in Almaty and Astana with OEP practice sets and international events.

name: Min-jun Kim
quote: “Reading empirical evidence critically is the most valuable habit an economics student can build.”
bio: Organizes student seminars in Seoul focused on interpreting economic data, trade policy, and market mechanisms.

name: Linh Nguyen
quote: “We focus on making every workshop interactive so students leave with clarity they can explain to someone else.”
bio: Leads student outreach and peer-facilitated economics workshops across high schools in Ho Chi Minh City.
